programs.title: Diploma in Library & Information Science (DLIS)
programs.name: Diploma in Library & Information Science (DLIS)
programs.eligibility: 10+2 or equivalent examination from a recognized board.
programs.overview:
The Diploma in Library & Information Science (DLIS) is a 1-year diploma program offered by LPU Online. The program provides fundamental knowledge of library management, information organization, cataloguing, classification, digital libraries, and modern information services.

Students develop practical skills in organizing library resources, managing digital information, documentation, and providing efficient information services. The flexible online learning format allows students to acquire professional knowledge while studying from anywhere.

Upon completion, graduates can pursue careers as Library Assistants, Documentation Assistants, Information Assistants, Digital Library Executives, Records Management Executives, and Information Service Professionals in schools, colleges, universities, government departments, and corporate organizations.

faqs.question: Are online degree programs UGC entiteld and valid for government jobs?
faqs.answer: Yes! As per UGC notification, online degrees awarded by recognized universities under UGC-DEB regulations are completely equivalent to regular degrees and valid for all government jobs, higher education, and corporate employment.

faqs.question: How are examinations conducted for online degrees?
faqs.answer: Most accredited universities conduct online proctored examinations that can be taken securely from home using a computer with webcam, or at designated examination centers.

faqs.question: Can I pay my tuition fee in installments or No-Cost EMI?
faqs.answer: Yes, almost all partner universities offer flexible semester-wise fee payment options as well as zero-interest EMI schemes through corporate banking partners.

faqs.question: What is the complete process to apply through Online Degree Diploma?
faqs.answer: Select your preferred university and program, submit a free enquiry or counselling request, speak with an academic advisor, upload eligibility documents, and complete your admission online.

faqs.question: What is an Online Degree Program?
faqs.answer: An online degree program allows students to complete their education remotely through digital learning platforms. Classes, study materials, assignments, and exams are conducted online by UGC-recognized universities.
